A '''gemwright''' was an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who worked with gems, specifically in fitting and fabricating them into objects like statues.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

[[Vilivian]] was a famous gemwright known for his intricately fitted gems.<ref name="MK" />
